title: Seeing Is Not Addressing: Auditing Linguistic Access to Frozen Visual Geometry

paragraphs.en: Visual distinctions are often finer than those reflected in linguistic conceptualization. Vision–language models exhibit a similar asymmetry: a distinction can remain discriminable in frozen image geometry while being weakly addressable through the native text interface. We study this gap by separating visual discriminability from linguistic addressability in text-to-image retrieval. Using FactorAtlas, a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning shape, hue, pattern, and nuisance variation, we compare both readouts on held-out images of the same distinctions. We then derive image-side contrasts that separate each value from its alternatives for matched visual grounding, and test whether this reduces the native-text access gap across factors and models. Direction-specific and visual-absence controls tie these gains to the relevant visual contrast; the gains persist after global alignment and extend to compositional retrieval and natural images. Together, these results show that visual discriminability and linguistic addressability need not coincide, and that matched visual grounding can probe and reduce the resulting access gap.

paragraphs.en: Visual representations often preserve finer distinctions than are reflected in linguistic conceptualization ( Liao et al., 2024 ) . Such distinctions become addressable through language when relevant words are linked to their visual referents, and these associations are learned through repeated co-occurrence ( Yu and Smith, 2007 ; Smith and Yu, 2008 ) . Contrastively trained vision–language models have a similar learning structure, acquiring cross-modal correspondences from large-scale paired image–text data ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) . The paired text, however, need not describe every visual distinction present in the image. Accordingly, in the resulting shared embedding space, some of these distinctions can remain discriminable in the image representation while being only weakly addressable through the model’s text interface.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉表现通常能保留比语言概念化所反映的更细微的区分（Liao 等，2024）。 当相关词语与其视觉参照物建立联系时，这些区分便可通过语言加以处理；而这种关联则是通过重复共现学习获得的（Yu 和 Smith，2007；Smith 和 Yu，2008）。 对比训练的视觉-语言模型具有类似的学习结构，它们从大规模配对的图像-文本数据中学习跨模态对应关系（Radford 等，2021；Zhai 等，2023）。 然而，配对的文本并不一定需要描述图像中存在的每一种视觉区分。 因此，在由此形成的共享嵌入空间中，这些区分中的某些部分可能仍然可以在图像表现中被识别，但通过模型的语言接口却只能被弱地处理。

paragraphs.en: In text-to-image retrieval , this asymmetry motivates separating two aspects of performance: whether image geometry supports the relevant visual distinction, and how well the native text query can access it. Related work shows that representations within each modality retain structured information ( Koishigarina et al., 2026 ) , with compositional and ordinal structure in image embeddings ( Berasi et al., 2025 ; Sonthalia et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, cross-modal alignment and mismatch have been studied at broader representational and compositional scales ( Liang et al., 2022 ; Kamath et al., 2023 ; Koishigarina et al., 2026 ) . We instead take each named visual distinction as the unit of analysis , asking how the image-side structure underlying its discriminability relates to native linguistic access.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本到图像检索中，这种不对称性促使我们将性能的两个方面区分开来：图像几何结构是否支持相关的视觉区分，以及原生文本查询能够多好地访问这种区分。 相关研究表明，每种模态内部的表示都保留了结构化信息（Koishigarina 等，2026），其中图像嵌入具有组合性和序数性结构（Berasi 等，2025；Sonthalia 等，2026）。 与此同时，跨模态对齐与不匹配已在更广泛的表示和组合尺度上得到了研究（Liang 等，2022；Kamath 等，2023；Koishigarina 等，2026）。 我们则将以每个命名的视觉区分作为分析单位，探讨其可区分性所依赖的图像侧结构与原生语言访问之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: We operationalize this question using FactorAtlas , a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning 8 shapes, 12 hues, 10 patterns, and 24 nuisance realizations. For each named factor value, we compare two readouts under held-out conditions: visual discriminability —how reliably each value can be distinguished from its alternatives in frozen image geometry—and linguistic addressability —how well the corresponding text query retrieves images exhibiting that value. We then derive a target-versus-rest visual contrast for each value and use its direction to ground the native text query. We call this matched visual grounding and test whether it improves distinction-specific linguistic access.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 FactorAtlas 来具体实施这一研究，这是一个完全交叉的实验平台，包含 23,040 张图像，涵盖了 8 种形状、12 种色调、10 种图案以及 24 种干扰性实现。 对于每个命名因子值，我们在预留条件下比较两种输出：视觉可区分性——即每种值在固定图像几何结构中能否可靠地区分出其替代值；以及语言可寻址性——即相应的文本查询能否有效检索到呈现该值的图像。 接着，我们为每个值推导出“目标与其余”的视觉对比，并利用其方向来确立原生文本查询的基础。 我们将这种匹配后的视觉基础称为“匹配视觉基础”，并测试它是否能提升针对特定区分的语言访问能力。

paragraphs.en: FactorAtlas is a procedurally rendered visual testbed designed to compare visual discriminability and linguistic addressability under controlled variation. It contains 23,040 images spanning 8 shapes, 12 hues, 10 surface patterns, and 24 nuisance realizations. Each realization is jointly determined by a context and renderer seed, varying object pose, viewpoint, illumination, background, and material appearance while preserving the underlying semantic factors. This lets the same semantic distinctions recur across varied visual conditions.
paragraphs.zh: FactorAtlas 是一个程序化渲染的视觉测试平台，旨在受控变化的条件下比较视觉可区分性与语言可指代性。 它包含 23,040 张图像，涵盖 8 种形状、12 种色调、10 种表面图案以及 24 种干扰实现。 每种实现都由上下文和渲染器种子共同决定，会变化物体姿态、视角、光照、背景和材质外观，同时保留底层的语义因素。 这使得相同的语义区分能够以不同视觉条件反复出现。

paragraphs.en: For each semantic factor, we evaluate all of its values jointly. When one factor is the target, the other factors are fully crossed and balanced, so every target value appears equally often with every combination of the remaining factors. This rules out simple cross-factor frequency shortcuts, preventing the readout from relying on correlations between the target value and the other factors.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个语义因素，我们都会联合评估其所有取值。 当一个因素为目标时，其他因素会完全交叉且平衡分布，因此每个目标值与其余因素的所有组合出现的频率均等。 这排除了简单的跨因素频率捷径，防止了读取结果依赖目标值与其他因素之间的相关性。

paragraphs.en: Our primary protocol holds out nuisance contexts, using four for calibration, two for validation, and six for testing, with both renderer seeds of each context assigned to the same split. For each factor value, the native text query is formed by averaging and renormalizing the embeddings of three fixed prompt templates specific to its factor. Calibration defines the visual support sets in Section 2.2 , while validation selects the factor-level grounding strength α \alpha . All choices are fixed before evaluation on held-out contexts, so the readouts are tested under nuisance conditions not used to construct or tune them. Full construction and evaluation details are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要协议会保留干扰性上下文：其中四个用于校准，两个用于验证，六个用于测试，且每个上下文的两个渲染器种子都被分配到同一划分中。 对于每个因子值，原生文本查询是通过对其特定因子的三个固定提示模板的嵌入向量进行平均和重新归一化来生成的。 校准定义了第 2.2 节中的视觉支持集，而验证则选择因子级别的接地强度 α \alpha。 所有选择在保留的上下文中进行评估之前均已固定，因此读数是在未用于构建或调整它们的干扰条件下进行测试的。 完整的构建和评估细节见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: On SigLIP2 Base, prototype-only grounding yields modest gains over the native query but remains consistently below matched grounding (Fig. 5 ). Moreover, assigning each target a nonmatching visual contrast sharply degrades retrieval, even when averaged over all nonmatching assignments. Together, these controls isolate what drives the access gain. Rather than reflecting generic attraction toward target images, the improvement depends specifically on the matched visual direction that separates the target from its alternatives. This interpretation is also consistent with the geometric guarantee, which applies to movement along the matched target-versus-rest visual contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SigLIP2 Base 上，仅使用原型进行 grounding 虽然比原始查询略有提升，但效果始终低于匹配 grounding（图 5）。 此外，为每个目标分配一个不匹配的视觉对比会严重降低检索效果，即使对所有不匹配分配取平均也是如此。 综合来看，这些对照实验明确了访问增益的具体驱动因素。 这种提升并非反映对目标图像的普遍吸引力，而是具体依赖于将目标与其替代选项区分开的匹配视觉方向。 这一解释也与几何保证一致，该保证适用于沿匹配的目标与其余项之间的视觉对比所进行的移动。

paragraphs.en: We also test a different kind of holdout based on semantic combinations. Here, individual factor values remain present in calibration, validation, and test, but some combinations of the two non-target factors appear in only one split. For example, when pattern is the target, evaluation uses hue–shape combinations that were not seen when the pattern directions were built or tuned. By design, all nuisance contexts and renderer seeds appear in every split, so the evaluation isolates unseen semantic combinations rather than unseen nuisance conditions. Matched visual grounding improves both metrics for all 21 backbone–factor combinations under this protocol. The access gains therefore do not depend on memorizing particular semantic combinations and generalize to new combinations of otherwise familiar factor values.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测试了一种基于语义组合的不同留置集方法。 在此方法中，各个因素的值在校准、验证和测试集中仍然存在，但两个非目标因素的一些组合仅出现在一个划分中。 例如，当模式为目标时，评估会使用在构建或调整模式方向时未出现过的色相–形状组合。 根据设计，所有干扰上下文和渲染器种子都会出现在每个划分中，因此该评估能够隔离未见的语义组合，而非未见的干扰条件。 在此协议下，匹配的视觉接地在所有 21 种骨干网络–因素组合中均提升了两项指标。 因此，访问能力的提升并不依赖于对特定语义组合的记忆，而是能够泛化到由原本熟悉的因素值构成的新组合。

paragraphs.en: We close this analysis by asking whether the access gaps identified for individual visual distinctions persist after a broader correction to the text–image representation geometry. Such broad approaches are common in prior work on fine-grained cross-modal alignment, where correspondence is improved through shared transformations applied across many distinctions rather than distinction-specific corrections. We test this using full-rank linear maps on the text representation, similar in spirit to prior work on linear cross-modal alignment ( Koishigarina et al., 2026 ; Moayeri et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个问题来结束本次分析：在文本与图像表示的几何结构上进行更广泛的修正后，针对个体视觉差异所识别出的访问差距是否仍然存在。 这类广泛的方法在以往关于细粒度跨模态对齐的研究中十分常见，其中，通过在许多差异上应用共享的变换（而非针对每个差异单独进行修正）来改善对应关系。 我们使用文本表示上的满秩线性映射来检验这一点，其思路与以往关于线性跨模态对齐的研究类似（Koishigarina 等人，2026；Moayeri 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Matched grounding is local to the visual contrast associated with each factor value, so improved access to an individual factor value does not by itself establish that the resulting queries remain compatible when several distinctions must be satisfied jointly. We therefore evaluate exact composition, where a query specifies one pattern, one hue, and one shape and the correct image must match all three values simultaneously. The exact target must outrank near-miss images that differ in one or more factors.

paragraphs.en: Vision–language models such as CLIP and SigLIP enable retrieval and zero-shot recognition through cross-modal similarity ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) . Yet benchmarks such as Winoground, VL-CheckList, SugarCrepe, and COLA reveal limitations of native vision–language matching on fine-grained attributes, relations, binding, and composition ( Thrush et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2022 ; Hsieh et al., 2023 ; Ray et al., 2023 ) . Recent work has further examined these challenges in multi-condition retrieval, attribute binding, and factorized inference ( Chow et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Alshehri et al., 2026 ) . Complementing these lines of work, we ask whether weak retrieval for a named visual distinction reflects limited image-side discriminability or limited access through the native text query.
paragraphs.zh: CLIP 和 SigLIP 等视觉-语言模型通过跨模态相似性实现了检索和零样本识别（Radford 等人，2021；Zhai 等人，2023）。 然而，Winoground、VL-CheckList、SugarCrepe 和 COLA 等基准测试揭示了原生视觉-语言匹配在精细属性、关系、绑定和组合方面的局限性（Thrush 等人，2022；Zhao 等人，2022；Hsieh 等人，2023；Ray 等人，2023）。 近期的研究进一步探讨了多条件检索、属性绑定和因子化推理中的这些挑战（Chow 等人，2026；Lu 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2025；Alshehri 等人，2026）。 作为对上述研究的补充，我们提出一个问题：对某个命名视觉差异的弱检索能力，究竟是反映了图像侧辨别能力的有限性，还是通过原生文本查询访问能力的有限性？

paragraphs.en: Shared VLM embedding spaces exhibit meaningful semantic structure across image and text representations ( Papadimitriou et al., 2025 ) . On the image side in particular, frozen embeddings preserve compositional organization and ordinal directions identifiable from visual examples ( Berasi et al., 2025 ; Sonthalia et al., 2026 ) . Yet information preserved within a modality may remain weakly accessible through native image–text similarity when image and text representations are not well aligned ( Koishigarina et al., 2026 ) . Building on this gap, we take each named visual distinction as the unit of analysis, enabling a finer-grained audit of the relation between image-side structure and linguistic access.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的 VLM 嵌入空间在图像和文本表示中展现出有意义的语义结构（Papadimitriou 等人，2025）。 特别是在图像方面，冻结的嵌入保留了可从视觉示例中识别出的组合结构和序数方向（Berasi 等人，2025；Sonthalia 等人，2026）。 然而，当图像和文本表示未良好对齐时，某一模态内保留的信息可能通过原生图像-文本相似性仅能微弱地获取（Koishigarina 等人，2026）。 基于这一差距，我们将每种命名的视觉差异作为分析单位，从而能够更精细地审查图像侧结构与语言可访问性之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: Prior work studies broad cross-modal mismatch ( Liang et al., 2022 ) and approaches for improving image–text correspondence through learned mappings, structure-preserving alignment, or stronger modality-specific representations ( Moayeri et al., 2023 ; Eslami and De Melo, 2024 ; Gröger et al., 2026 ; Gong et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Among these approaches, LABCLIP improves attribute–object correspondence through a learned transformation shared across text embeddings ( Koishigarina et al., 2026 ) . Support-based adaptation provides another related direction, using labeled visual examples to improve downstream performance with frozen vision–language models ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) . In our approach, we focus on distinction-specific access, deriving a matched target-versus-rest contrast for each visual value and using it to adjust the native text query on held-out data. This value-specific intervention tests whether the corresponding image-side structure can reduce the access gap, including after global alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作研究了广泛的跨模态不匹配问题（Liang 等人，2022），以及通过学习映射、结构保留对齐或更强的模态特定表示来改善图像与文本对应关系的方法（Moayeri 等人，2023；Eslami 和 De Melo，2024；Gröger 等人，2026；Gong 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2026）。 在这些方法中，LABCLIP 通过一种共享于文本嵌入的 learned 变换来改善属性与对象之间的对应关系（Koishigarina 等人，2026）。 基于支持的方法提供了另一个相关方向，即利用带标签的视觉示例，在冻结的视觉-语言模型上提升下游任务性能（Zhang 等人，2021）。 在我们的方法中，我们专注于区分特定的访问机制，为每个视觉值推导出匹配的目标与其余项对比，并利用它来调整保留数据上的原始文本查询。 这种针对特定值的干预旨在检验：相应的图像侧结构是否能够在包括全局对齐之后，有效缩小访问差距。

paragraphs.en: This interpretation is supported by direction-specific and visual-evidence controls, robustness across models and held-out conditions, and residual gains after global alignment. More broadly, strong aggregate cross-modal alignment does not by itself ensure reliable linguistic access to every distinction that remains discriminable in image geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 这种解释得到了方向特定控制和视觉证据控制、跨模型和预留条件的稳健性，以及全局对齐后的残余增益的支持。 对单个因子值的访问权限提升，支持了精确的组合式检索和以验证为指导的选择性接地，而相同的匹配接地逻辑也适用于自然图像的区分。 更广泛地说，强大的聚合跨模态对齐本身并不能确保可靠的语言访问图像几何中所有仍可区分的差异。

paragraphs.en: These conclusions are conditioned on visual discriminability. Access gains vary across settings, the geometric guarantee is local, and the global maps cover only one family of broader alignment corrections. Within this scope, what frozen image geometry can reliably distinguish and what the native language interface can reliably address should be treated as separate empirical questions. When a distinction remains visually discriminable but linguistically under-addressed, matched visual grounding provides a held-out intervention that tests this diagnosis and can improve linguistic access. Extending this perspective beyond predefined distinctions and labeled visual support could enable vision–language systems to more flexibly expose and use visual structure that their representations already support, even when that structure is not well captured by the native language interface.

paragraphs.en: FactorAtlas is the complete product of 10 patterns, 12 hues, 8 shapes, 12 nuisance contexts, and two renderer replicas, totaling 23,040 images. paragraphs.en: We begin with the comparison that does not modify the text query. paragraphs.en: Target-prototype attraction improves over native retrieval in all 21 backbone–factor cases, showing that target attraction alone can yield gains. However, target-versus-rest grounding performs better than prototype attraction in all 21 cases. Across factors and backbones, macro-mAP increases from .616 .616 under native retrieval to .674 .674 with prototype attraction and .817 .817 with target-versus-rest grounding. Thus, target attraction alone does not explain the observed access gain; explicitly isolating the visual distinction between each value and its alternatives yields substantially larger held-out gains. This held-out result is separate from, but consistent with, the local geometric guarantee for movement along the matched target-versus-average-rest calibration gap.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有 21 种骨干网络–因子组合中，目标原型吸引效果均优于原生检索，表明仅靠目标吸引即可带来性能提升。 然而，在所有 21 种情况下，目标与其余项的接地方法表现均优于原型吸引。 在不同因子和骨干网络中，宏观 mAP 从原生检索下的 .616 .616 提升至原型吸引下的 .674 .674，以及目标与其余项接地下的 .817 .817。 因此，仅靠目标吸引无法解释观察到的访问增益；明确区分每个值与其替代项的视觉差异，能带来显著更大的预留集性能提升。 这一预留集结果独立于匹配目标与平均其余项校准差距沿该差距移动时的局部几何保证，但与之一致。

paragraphs.en: The direct comparison above still leaves open whether global alignment and matched grounding address the same part of the mismatch. We therefore apply them sequentially. For post-global evaluation, the selected global map is first frozen. Image directions are then recomputed from calibration data, and a new factor-level α \alpha is selected on validation. The global map is never updated using the residual result, and test data are used only for the final evaluation. A positive gain therefore means that value-matched image-side structure remains useful for improving access after the broad transformation has already been applied.

paragraphs.en: The first table aggregates the six factor–protocol endpoints, whereas Table 21 separates the three factors after averaging the two protocols. Access gains and direction quality increase smoothly with support size. Thirty-two images per value achieve about 81% of the full-support gain, and 64 achieve about 89%. Shape is already close to its full-support mAP at moderate budgets, whereas pattern benefits more strongly from additional support. The positive one-shot mean does not imply a stable one-shot direction: its mean cosine to the full-support direction is only .466 .466 . Thus the sweep shows that substantial access gains can be obtained with limited labeled support at the aggregate level, while also showing why the full calibration set is preferable for a stable geometric estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 第一张表汇总了六个因素-协议端点，而表21则在平均两个协议后分别列出三个因素。 访问增益和方向质量会随着支持规模的增大而平稳提升。 每个值使用三十二张图像可获得约81%的全支持增益，而使用六十四张图像则可达约89%。 在中等预算下，形状已接近其全支持状态下的mAP，而模式则能从额外支持中获益更多。 正向的单次样本均值并不意味着稳定的单次样本方向：它与全支持方向的平均余弦值仅为0.466。 因此，该扫描结果表明，在汇总层面上，即使使用有限的标注支持也能获得显著的访问增益；同时这也解释了为何稳定的几何估计更倾向于使用完整的校准集。

paragraphs.en: The resulting cohort contains 2,400 crops, balanced over the Cartesian product of six patterns and four garment categories. We perform four leave-one-category-out evaluations. For each run, one garment category supplies the entire test gallery and is excluded from both direction estimation and grounding-strength selection. This tests whether pattern directions estimated from other garment categories transfer to a previously unseen garment category.

paragraphs.en: We separately evaluate an eight-value garment-length vocabulary: mini , micro , above-the-knee , knee , midi , below-the-knee , maxi , and floor . The cohort contains 2,847 localized dress crops.

paragraphs.en: Five source-image-disjoint calibration–validation rotations are constructed from the Fashionpedia training set. The untouched Fashionpedia validation gallery is used as test in every rotation. Consequently, variation across rotations measures robustness to the calibration and validation samples rather than uncertainty from different test galleries.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Fashionpedia 训练集中构建五个与源图像无关的校准-验证轮次。 未经修改的 Fashionpedia 验证图库在每次轮次中均用作测试集。 因此，不同轮次之间的差异反映的是对校准和验证样本的稳健性，而非来自不同测试图库的不确定性。

sents.en: Five source-image-disjoint calibration–validation rotations are constructed from the Fashionpedia training set.
sents.zh: 从 Fashionpedia 训练集中构建五个与源图像无关的校准-验证轮次。

paragraphs.en: During cohort construction, local English descriptions from LOTS/Sketchy ( Girella et al., 2025 ) were linked to the Fashionpedia examples. However, the evaluated images, garment boxes, category labels, and visual attributes come from Fashionpedia, and retrieval uses fixed factor prompts rather than the LOTS sketch-generation task. We therefore refer to the evaluated dataset as Fashionpedia while recording both sources in the data provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 在数据集构建过程中，来自 LOTS/Sketchy（Girella 等人，2025）的本地英文描述被关联到了 Fashionpedia 的示例中。 然而，经过评估的图像、服装框、类别标签和视觉属性均源自 Fashionpedia，而检索过程使用的是固定的因子提示，而非 LOTS 的草图生成任务。 因此，我们将经过评估的数据集称为 Fashionpedia，同时在数据溯源中记录了这两个来源。

sents.en: During cohort construction, local English descriptions from LOTS/Sketchy ( Girella et al., 2025 ) were linked to the Fashionpedia examples.
sents.zh: 在数据集构建过程中，来自 LOTS/Sketchy（Girella 等人，2025）的本地英文描述被关联到了 Fashionpedia 的示例中。

paragraphs.en: We join official COCO-Facet material labels with COCO-Stuff localization ( Caesar et al., 2018 ) . We retain images containing exactly one requested material label and exclude images containing a segment from another requested material class.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将官方的 COCO-Facet 材料标签与 COCO-Stuff 定位信息（Caesar 等人，2018）相结合。 我们保留恰好包含一个所需材料标签的图像，并排除包含另一个所需材料类别分段的图像。

sents.en: We join official COCO-Facet material labels with COCO-Stuff localization ( Caesar et al., 2018 ) .
sents.zh: 我们将官方的 COCO-Facet 材料标签与 COCO-Stuff 定位信息（Caesar 等人，2018）相结合。

sents.en: We retain images containing exactly one requested material label and exclude images containing a segment from another requested material class.
sents.zh: 我们保留恰好包含一个所需材料标签的图像，并排除包含另一个所需材料类别分段的图像。

paragraphs.en: For each image, the natural crop is the tight bounding box of the largest individual target-material segment. It is not the union of spatially disconnected segments. We apply fixed inclusion criteria requiring the target mask to occupy at least 1 % 1\% of the image, fill at least 25 % 25\% of its bounding box, and have a box covering at most 50 % 50\% of the full image. We additionally require at least 24 images per material class.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每张图像，自然裁剪区域是最大单个目标材料片段的最小包围框。 它并非空间上不相连的片段之和。 我们应用固定的包含标准，要求目标掩码至少占据图像的 1%（1\%），填满其包围框的至少 25%（25\%），且该包围框覆盖整个图像的面积最多不超过 50%（50\%）。 此外，我们还要求每种材料类别至少包含 24 张图像。

sents.en: For each image, the natural crop is the tight bounding box of the largest individual target-material segment.
sents.zh: 对于每张图像，自然裁剪区域是最大单个目标材料片段的最小包围框。

sents.en: It is not the union of spatially disconnected segments.
sents.zh: 它并非空间上不相连的片段之和。

sents.en: We apply fixed inclusion criteria requiring the target mask to occupy at least 1 % 1\% of the image, fill at least 25 % 25\% of its bounding box, and have a box covering at most 50 % 50\% of the full image.
sents.zh: 我们应用固定的包含标准，要求目标掩码至少占据图像的 1%（1\%），填满其包围框的至少 25%（25\%），且该包围框覆盖整个图像的面积最多不超过 50%（50\%）。

sents.en: We additionally require at least 24 images per material class.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还要求每种材料类别至少包含 24 张图像。

paragraphs.en: The resulting cohort contains 306 images: 172 metal , 29 stone , and 105 wood . Five deterministic rotations are image-disjoint across calibration, validation, and test. The main-paper result uses the unmodified natural crop.
paragraphs.zh: 最终生成的数据集包含 306 张图像：172 张金属、29 张石头和 105 张木材。 五种确定性旋转在校准集、验证集和测试集中彼此图像不重叠。 主论文的结果使用了未经修改的自然裁剪方式。

sents.en: The resulting cohort contains 306 images: 172 metal , 29 stone , and 105 wood .
sents.zh: 最终生成的数据集包含 306 张图像：172 张金属、29 张石头和 105 张木材。

sents.en: Five deterministic rotations are image-disjoint across calibration, validation, and test.
sents.zh: 五种确定性旋转在校准集、验证集和测试集中彼此图像不重叠。

sents.en: The main-paper result uses the unmodified natural crop.
sents.zh: 主论文的结果使用了未经修改的自然裁剪方式。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four footwear materials: Leather , Suede , Patent Leather , and Synthetic . The cohort is restricted to a fixed footwear stratum and balances material counts within retained toe-style–heel-height cells.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了四种鞋材：皮革、绒面革、漆皮和合成材料。 该队列限定于一个固定的鞋类层级，并在保留的鞋头样式与鞋跟高度组合单元内平衡各类材料的数量。

sents.en: We evaluate four footwear materials: Leather , Suede , Patent Leather , and Synthetic .
sents.zh: 我们评估了四种鞋材：皮革、绒面革、漆皮和合成材料。

sents.en: The cohort is restricted to a fixed footwear stratum and balances material counts within retained toe-style–heel-height cells.
sents.zh: 该队列限定于一个固定的鞋类层级，并在保留的鞋头样式与鞋跟高度组合单元内平衡各类材料的数量。

paragraphs.en: We retain one deterministic image per product, yielding 96 products with 24 products per material. Products never cross calibration, validation, and test roles. Results are averaged over five product-disjoint rotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个产品保留一张确定性图像，最终得到 96 个产品，每种材料对应 24 个产品。 产品绝不会跨越校准、验证和测试角色。 结果是在五个互不重叠的产品旋转上取平均值得到的。

sents.en: We retain one deterministic image per product, yielding 96 products with 24 products per material.
sents.zh: 我们为每个产品保留一张确定性图像，最终得到 96 个产品，每种材料对应 24 个产品。

sents.en: Products never cross calibration, validation, and test roles.
sents.zh: 产品绝不会跨越校准、验证和测试角色。

sents.en: Results are averaged over five product-disjoint rotations.
sents.zh: 结果是在五个互不重叠的产品旋转上取平均值得到的。

paragraphs.en: The matched natural-image experiments above estimate visual contrasts and select grounding strength separately within each target dataset. We additionally ask a stricter question: when two domains share the same visual distinction, can image-side directions estimated in one domain remain useful in the other without any target-side fitting or validation? We test this using the four pattern values shared by FactorAtlas and Fashionpedia.
paragraphs.zh: 上述匹配的天然图像实验分别估算了每个目标数据集中的视觉对比度并选择了接地强度。 我们进一步提出了一个更严格的问题：当两个领域共享相同的视觉区分特征时，在一个领域中估算出的图像侧指导信息是否可以在另一个领域中继续使用，而无需进行任何目标侧的拟合或验证？ 我们使用 FactorAtlas 和 Fashionpedia 共享的四种模式值来检验这一点。

sents.en: The matched natural-image experiments above estimate visual contrasts and select grounding strength separately within each target dataset.
sents.zh: 上述匹配的天然图像实验分别估算了每个目标数据集中的视觉对比度并选择了接地强度。

sents.en: We additionally ask a stricter question: when two domains share the same visual distinction, can image-side directions estimated in one domain remain useful in the other without any target-side fitting or validation?
sents.zh: 我们进一步提出了一个更严格的问题：当两个领域共享相同的视觉区分特征时，在一个领域中估算出的图像侧指导信息是否可以在另一个领域中继续使用，而无需进行任何目标侧的拟合或验证？

sents.en: We test this using the four pattern values shared by FactorAtlas and Fashionpedia.
sents.zh: 我们使用 FactorAtlas 和 Fashionpedia 共享的四种模式值来检验这一点。

paragraphs.en: For each backbone, we construct FactorAtlas pattern directions from the complete ten-value vocabulary using the four calibration contexts and reuse the corresponding grounding strength selected in FactorAtlas. No Fashionpedia image is used to estimate a direction or select the grounding strength. We map FactorAtlas plain , striped , checkered , and dotted to Fashionpedia plain , stripe , check , and dot , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个主干结构，我们利用四个校准上下文，从完整的十值词汇表中构建 FactorAtlas 模式方向，并复用 FactorAtlas 中已选定的对应接地强度。 没有使用任何 Fashionpedia 图像来估计方向或选择接地强度。 我们将 FactorAtlas 中的纯色、条纹、棋盘格和圆点图案分别映射到 Fashionpedia 中的纯色、条纹、棋盘格和圆点。

sents.en: For each backbone, we construct FactorAtlas pattern directions from the complete ten-value vocabulary using the four calibration contexts and reuse the corresponding grounding strength selected in FactorAtlas.
sents.zh: 对于每个主干结构，我们利用四个校准上下文，从完整的十值词汇表中构建 FactorAtlas 模式方向，并复用 FactorAtlas 中已选定的对应接地强度。

sents.en: No Fashionpedia image is used to estimate a direction or select the grounding strength.
sents.zh: 没有使用任何 Fashionpedia 图像来估计方向或选择接地强度。

sents.en: We map FactorAtlas plain , striped , checkered , and dotted to Fashionpedia plain , stripe , check , and dot , respectively.
sents.zh: 我们将 FactorAtlas 中的纯色、条纹、棋盘格和圆点图案分别映射到 Fashionpedia 中的纯色、条纹、棋盘格和圆点。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all four Fashionpedia category-held-out partitions. Each held-out gallery contains 600 images spanning all six Fashionpedia pattern labels, so the two unmapped labels remain natural negatives rather than being removed from the gallery. Across seven backbones, directly reusing the FactorAtlas directions improves macro-mAP from .583 .583 to .719 .719 (Table 23 ). The aggregate gain is positive for all seven backbones and for all 28 backbone–partition evaluations. At the individual backbone–value level, 20 of 28 cases improve, indicating that cross-dataset reuse is consistent in aggregate but remains value-dependent. These results suggest that when the same visual distinction is shared across domains, its image-side direction can remain useful beyond the data from which it was estimated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 Fashionpedia 所有四个类别保留划分。 每个保留的图库包含 600 张图像，涵盖了 Fashionpedia 的全部六个图案标签，因此两个未映射的标签仍作为自然负例存在，而不是从图库中移除。 在七种骨干模型中，直接复用 FactorAtlas 的方向将宏观 mAP 从 .583 .583 提升至 .719 .719（表 23）。 对于全部七种骨干模型以及所有 28 种骨干模型与划分的评估，总体增益均为正值。 在单个骨干模型与数值的层面上，28 个案例中有 20 个得到改善，表明跨数据集的复用总体上具有一致性，但仍取决于具体数值。 这些结果表明，当相同的视觉区分特征在不同领域中被共享时，其图像侧的方向性仍能超越最初估计它的数据集继续发挥作用。

sents.en: We evaluate all four Fashionpedia category-held-out partitions.
sents.zh: 我们评估了 Fashionpedia 所有四个类别保留划分。

sents.en: Each held-out gallery contains 600 images spanning all six Fashionpedia pattern labels, so the two unmapped labels remain natural negatives rather than being removed from the gallery.
sents.zh: 每个保留的图库包含 600 张图像，涵盖了 Fashionpedia 的全部六个图案标签，因此两个未映射的标签仍作为自然负例存在，而不是从图库中移除。

sents.en: Across seven backbones, directly reusing the FactorAtlas directions improves macro-mAP from .583 .583 to .719 .719 (Table 23 ).
sents.zh: 在七种骨干模型中，直接复用 FactorAtlas 的方向将宏观 mAP 从 .583 .583 提升至 .719 .719（表 23）。

sents.en: The aggregate gain is positive for all seven backbones and for all 28 backbone–partition evaluations.
sents.zh: 对于全部七种骨干模型以及所有 28 种骨干模型与划分的评估，总体增益均为正值。

sents.en: At the individual backbone–value level, 20 of 28 cases improve, indicating that cross-dataset reuse is consistent in aggregate but remains value-dependent.
sents.zh: 在单个骨干模型与数值的层面上，28 个案例中有 20 个得到改善，表明跨数据集的复用总体上具有一致性，但仍取决于具体数值。

sents.en: These results suggest that when the same visual distinction is shared across domains, its image-side direction can remain useful beyond the data from which it was estimated.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，当相同的视觉区分特征在不同领域中被共享时，其图像侧的方向性仍能超越最初估计它的数据集继续发挥作用。
